entry.title: 85 Sky Tower (Tuntex)
entry.note: Fresh OSM API on 2026-10-10 confirms exact Q337631 podium 34170948 and six unchanged separately retained parts: north/south prongs, central sill, elevated shaft, hip roof and antenna. Heading -1.245554419864 retained: native +X south-southeast along prong separation, +Z west-southwest toward the harbor. Native +X follows the long podium axis. Independent antenna 345038767 and asymmetric mapped prongs corroborate signed frame; architect harbor and aerial photos establish both open aperture and raised podium. Ground Y=0 is street entry; 13.1 m ground passage and 70–145 m upper aperture are photo/map reconstructions. Accept 2 m footprint / 1 degree reconstruction allowance; automatic replacement disabled. Surrounding towers, street canopy stalls and local grade are separate context. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.
